scope: compared with X_ITE 16.6.0 in scene mode: sensors in a Transform with a Shape sibling (X_ITE 16.6.0 does not traverse a group that holds only a pick sensor, so the fixtures add a 0.02 unit Box beside each sensor); BOUNDS and GEOMETRY (Sphere against Box where the boxes overlap and the geometries do not), sortOrder CLOSEST / ANY / ALL / ALL_SORTED, objectType filter, pickable false, enabled false
a shape outside every PickableGroup is not pickable here (as 19775-1 asks); X_ITE 16.6.0 picks it, the fixture checks it in ours only
disabling a sensor that is active raises isActive false here; X_ITE 16.6.0 keeps it true, checked in ours only
a Sphere picking geometry is a 162 point hull (0.4 percent inside the true sphere); the target is the convex hull of its mesh, so a concave target counts as its hull, as in X_ITE 16.6.0
the pickingGeometry is read at build; a replaced pickingGeometry node is picked up on the next timestamp; non-uniform scale on the sensor is applied to the hull
